# teams agent

Manage Microsoft Agent 365 agents

## Usage

```
teams agent
```
<!-- AUTOGENERATED:END -->

## Details

Commands for creating [Microsoft Agent 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-agent-365/developer/registration) agents — the Entra agent blueprint, its agent identity, and its agentic user account.

These commands call Microsoft Graph and the Teams Developer Portal API directly (no `a365` CLI or .NET runtime required).

- [`teams agent blueprint`](./blueprint) — create, update, or delete the agent's blueprint (its Entra app + credentials)
- [`teams agent user`](./user) — create the agentic user (and its identity + blueprint if needed)

Start with `teams agent blueprint create` if you just need the blueprint, or `teams agent user create` for the full agentic user flow in one step.
